name: David Boies
tagline: Top rated Antitrust Litigation attorney in Armonk, New York
about: David Boies is an attorney who represents clients in the Armonk, New York area. David Boies is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2007 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

David Boies chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended Yale Law School and graduated in 1966. David Boies passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1967.
He represents clients with Antitrust Litigation issues in New York. He also represents clients with Criminal Defense: White Collar and Securities Litigation issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, David Boies has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
